pkgmetadata.longdescription: Meta package mirroring upstream pkgbuilds/omarchy: ships the omarchy-* runtime CLI, theme bundles, quickshell shell tree, migrations and setup scripts, and pulls in the whole desktop dependency set (Hyprland, Quickshell, SDDM, portals, PipeWire, ...). Pacman-bound scripts (omarchy update, omarchy pkg ...) are re-authored against portage in files/gentoo-bin; everything else is upstream verbatim at the pinned commit shared with app-misc/omarchy-settings. The legacy-only omarchy-completions atom ships folded into this package.
